result:
T-DG3-FE-F is fixed. A refused G4 submission now lists each missing item on its own line, translated, and in Arabic no English label appears. Every acceptance check exits 0, including the whole product e2e suite in both projects and both locale settings. Nothing is committed: the changes are in the `dg3/fe-f` worktree for you to commit and merge.

**What changed**
- **The fix** (`apps/web/src/pages/gates/GateDetailPage.tsx`): the dialog no longer reads the server's joined English message.
  - It lists the items from the gate view (`criteria[].missing[]`). Each one shows its translated label and the initiative's own code and name.
  - After a 409 or 422 it refreshes through `useP3Refresh`; no `setQueryData`.
  - If the gate view can't be loaded, it shows one translated title per refused criterion.
  - G1–G3 refusals go through the unchanged DG2 code.
- **Readiness table:** it uses the same lookup, so G4 items there also show the record's name, translated card field names and translated section titles instead of raw codes.
- **Labels** (`i18n/{en,ar}/gates.json`): I added the missing `g4__initiative_card_incomplete` label, 8 criterion titles for the fallback (Arabic copied from the seeded labels), and two subject labels.
- **Tests:** 5 new unit tests in `g4.test.tsx` (EN and AR), and the new e2e spec `apps/web/e2e/p3-g4-refusal.spec.ts`. The spec builds a fully G4-ready portfolio of two selected initiatives through the real API, because the UI only enables Submit when every criterion is complete. The lead opens the submit dialog, both workstream leads are cleared in another session, and the lead submits. The spec then checks for exactly two translated "Owners" items, one per initiative. In Arabic, neither the alert nor the dialog contains any of five English labels ("Owners", "Finance validation", "Gap link missing", "Funding decision missing", "Capacity commitment missing").

**Checks run** (all exit 0; logs in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG3/T-DG3-FE-F-evidence/`)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG2`, at start and end | PASS |
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, prettier check, `check:contrast` | all exit 0 |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset and C.UTF-8 | 1528/1528 each (FE-D's 1523 plus my 5) |
| New spec | 4 passed (2 chromium-en, 2 chromium-ar) |
| Whole e2e suite, locale unset | 168 passed, 12.3 min |
| Whole e2e suite, C.UTF-8 | 168 passed, 11.9 min |

Per-spec counts were the same in both locale settings, with 0 failed, flaky or skipped. FE-D's existing G4 refusal step in `p3-journeys.spec.ts` still passes. The per-spec table is in the handback.

Earlier runs of the new spec failed twice before I got it working, and both causes are fixed:
- The setup lacked business-case lines, which the investment and benefits sections need.
- Axe flagged a serious contrast failure for links inside the red error banner. The CSS that controls that is outside my file scope, so the dialog now shows plain text. The readiness table behind the dialog still links each item.

**Screenshots** (I viewed both; EN and AR each show two separate translated lines):
- `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG3/T-DG3-FE-F-evidence/screenshots/en/p3-g4-refusal-two-owners.png`
- `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG3/T-DG3-FE-F-evidence/screenshots/ar/p3-g4-refusal-two-owners.png`

**Known gaps**
- For a moment after a 422, while the gate view reloads, a criterion that looked complete before shows its translated title instead of its items. It never shows English.
- A missing Finance validation item names only the record type ("Business case" or "Benefit formula"), not the case or formula title.
- For capacity conflicts, the role name comes from the server's English role label, so in Arabic a role's English name can appear as data. Fixing that needs a backend change.

**Merge notes:** no migrations, and I expect no conflicts with BE-G or the analyst's work. Do not stage the untracked files at the repository root (`.bashrc`, `.mcp.json` and similar); the sandbox created them and they are not project files.

The handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG3/T-DG3-FE-F-frontend-ux-engineer.md`.
